name: Flask to FastAPI Migration Pack
trustedExecutionNote: Packs execute shell commands (perStepTypecheckCmd, checkpointTestCmd, snapshot commands). Only load trusted packs.
knownLimitations: Flask's thread-local `request`/`g` have no FastAPI analogue; endpoints must accept explicit `Request`/dependency-injected parameters.
Non-strict typechecking (`mypy --ignore-missing-imports`) is used because Flask lacks complete type stubs, so some type errors may pass through intermediate steps.

packageDetectors.description: Confirms the target is a Flask (Python) project.
Reports whether FastAPI is already declared as a target dependency.

detectionRules.description: Import of the thread-local `request` (or `g`) from flask.
Flask response/helper calls: jsonify, abort, render_template, make_response, redirect.

agentGuidance.MIGRATE: Convert Flask views to FastAPI. Create the app as `app = FastAPI()`. Replace `@app.route(path, methods=[...])` with explicit method decorators `@app.get(path)` / `@app.post(path)` etc. Make view functions `async def` and accept explicit typed parameters (e.g. `user_id: int`, `request: Request`) instead of the thread-local `flask.request`; read query/body via `request.query_params` / `await request.json()`. Replace `jsonify(x)` with returning `x` (or `JSONResponse`), and `abort(code)` with `raise HTTPException(status_code=code)`. Convert `<int:id>` path params to `{id}`. Do NOT include any `# @bkb-shim` comments.
agentGuidance.SHIM: This module has unmigrated upstream callers (`pendingCallersCount > 0`) and must remain importable while they still call Flask-style functions. Provide a dual-signature helper: accept either the FastAPI `Request`/dependency object or fall back to the Flask thread-local (`flask.request`), tagged with `# @bkb-shim`. Keep both the legacy Flask route handler and the new FastAPI handler available so partial migrations still import and run. Tag ONLY the legacy Flask fallback lines with `# @bkb-shim`.
agentGuidance.DE_SHIM: All upstream callers are now migrated (`pendingCallersCount == 0`). Remove every `flask.request`/`g` fallback and every `# @bkb-shim` comment so the module uses pure FastAPI (`Request`, `HTTPException`, typed parameters) throughout.
